messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [INC-2067891234] Unusual auth failure spike detected on /v1/auth (prod). 3.5k 401s in 60s, surge from ~8 IPs. Severity: potential credential stuffing or header leak. See https://redwood/ops/incidents/INC-2067891234

pagerbot: paging @alex (oncall) :rotating_light: Please ACK and triage.

alex: Acked. I'm oncall. Looking at logs now. Any initial scope on customer-facing failures?

incident-bot: spike-source-sample: 203.0.113.45, 203.0.113.46, 198.51.100.12. Rate pattern: token reuse with different usernames. No successful logins observed in sampling.

marta: joining (security-oncall). Adding me to channel. If header leakage suspected we need to consider key rotation for affected service accounts. Any sign of requests containing full Authorization bearer tokens in log payloads?

alex: quick grep over ingress-logs shows auth header fragments in a staging-forwarder debug log that was enabled last week. I don't see full tokens in public S3 buckets yet. Running a broader scan across prod/staging buckets.

sam: I'll start rotation for svc-account:indexer if you want. Also recommend we block offending IP ranges at the WAF while we assess.

alex: applying WAF block now: 
```
# ipset add suspicious_src 203.0.113.45
# ipset add suspicious_src 203.0.113.46
# wafctl update-blocklist --ids suspicious_src
```
Applying... done. Seeing immediate drop in 401 rate.

infra-bot: log-forwarder report: no external buckets received forwarded logs in last 3h. Last forward to external was 2024-11-05T02:15Z -> s3://partner-ingest/ (staging). No writes to public buckets from prod-logs.

marta: good. Sam, please start token rotation for indexer and any service accounts that emit headers to forwarders. Follow runbook SEC-ROTATE-TOKENS: https://redwood/runbooks/sec-rotate-tokens

sam: creating new key in KMS and triggering rolling deploy. ETA ~8m. Command: `kms create-key --alias indexer-rot-2067 && deploy service/indexer --env prod --restart`

alex: monitoring metrics: 401 spike down ~92% in last 5m. Will continue run grep over last 72h in prod/staging for "Authorization: Bearer" phrases. If we find full tokens in any S3 objects, escalate to legal.

carol: (support) I'll prepare a short status page update: "Investigating unusual authentication traffic; no customer impact observed at this time." Will post once we confirm containment.

alex: grep results (sample):
```
prod-forwarder-debug.log: [2025-04-02T14:08:12Z] DEBUG payload truncated: "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci... (truncated fragment)"
staging-debug.log: similar truncated fragments in internal buffer, no full tokens in S3 objects.
```

marta: sounds contained to internal debug buffers so far. Still rotate keys and perform full audit across retention buckets. Sam, confirm rotation completed and provide new key thumbprint.

sam: rotation complete. New key alias indexer-rot-2067 created. Rolling deploy finished at 2025-04-02T14:22Z. Thumbprint: abcd:1234 (partial). Updated service configs and invalidated old key.

alex: no signs of successful account takeovers. No customer tokens observed in external buckets. Support posted status page: https://status.redwood/incident/INC-2067891234

marta: opening incident ticket INC-2067891234-FollowUp. Owners: security (marta), infra (alex), support (carol). Priority: P1 for follow-up audit, but live impact reduced to low. I'll loop in legal for potential data exposure review.

carol: noted. I'll keep customers updated and create an internal postmortem draft.

alex: handing to overnight oncall (sam) in 15m. @sam you'll monitor for recurrence (>10% spike) and escalate to pager if seen.

sam: Ack. Leaving long-grep running, tailing auth metrics, and will escalate immediately. If anything crops up I'll open a new page.

incident-bot: UPDATE: spike suppressed, incident marked as contained. Continued follow-up required: key rotation confirmation, S3 scan results, and postmortem. Closing live page at 2025-04-02T14:35Z.

marta: thanks everyone. We'll run the follow-up audit tomorrow and schedule a short postmortem. :white_check_mark:
